StormblastBoltsPlayer.description: Aims skyward and fires charged bolts that land around the target location, dealing damage and lodging in the ground for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause these bolts to explode. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.

StormcallerArrowPlayer.name: Stormcaller Arrow
StormcallerArrowPlayer.description: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock. Shocking any enemy with the Bolt also applies Shock to all enemies near the impact.

SummonBeastPlayer.name: Companion: {0}
SummonBeastPlayer.description: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

SummonFireDjinnPlayer.name: Ruzhan, the Blazing Sword
SummonFireDjinnPlayer.description: Summon Ruzhan, an invulnerable Flame Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Ruzhan emerges to Strike enemies with his greatsword whenever you use a damaging Skill, and casts devastating Fire Spells when Commanded to do so.

SummonInfernalHoundPlayer.name: Summon Infernal Hound
SummonInfernalHoundPlayer.description: Activate to summon a Reviving Infernal Hound which Ignites enemies near it.

SummonMetaTotemSpellTotemPlayer.name: Spell Totem
SummonMetaTotemSpellTotemPlayer.description: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.

SummonSandDjinnPlayer.name: Kelari, the Tainted Sands
SummonSandDjinnPlayer.description: Summon Kelari, an invulnerable Sand Djinn Minion, to do your bidding. Kelari will only act when you Command him to do so. Kelari delivers swift Hits with massive Critical Hit potential.

SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.name: Skeletal Arsonist Minion
SummonSkeletalArsonistsPlayer.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.

SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.name: Skeletal Brute Minion
SummonSkeletalBrutesPlayer.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.name: Skeletal Cleric Minion
SummonSkeletalClericsPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Frost Mage Minion
SummonSkeletalFrostMagesPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.

SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.name: Skeletal Reaver Minion
SummonSkeletalReaversPlayer.description: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage

SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.name: Skeletal Sniper Minion
SummonSkeletalSnipersPlayer.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.name: Skeletal Storm Mage Minion
SummonSkeletalStormMagesPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.

SummonSkeletalWarriorsPlayer.name: Skeletal Warrior Minion
SummonSkeletalWarriorsPlayer.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.

SummonSpectrePlayer.name: Spectre: {0}
SummonSpectrePlayer.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

SummonWaterDjinnPlayer.name: Navira, the Last Mirage
SummonWaterDjinnPlayer.description: Summon Navira, an invulnerable Water Djinn Minion to do your bidding. Navira will only act when you Command her to do so, bestowing restorative blessings upon you and your Allies with her Spells.

SunderPlayer.name: Sunder
SunderPlayer.description: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.

SuperchargedSlamPlayer.name: Supercharged Slam
SuperchargedSlamPlayer.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area.

SupportAbidingHexPlayer.name: Abiding Hex
SupportAbidingHexPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do.

SupportAcrimonyPlayer.name: Acrimony
SupportAcrimonyPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.name: Chaos Attunement
SupportAddedChaosDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.name: Cold Attunement
SupportAddedColdDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.name: Fire Attunement
SupportAddedFireDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.name: Lightning Attunement
SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.name: Adhesive Grenades I
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.name: Adhesive Grenades II
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

SupportAdmixturePlayer.name: Admixture
SupportAdmixturePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

SupportAdvancingStormPlayer.name: Advancing Storm
SupportAdvancingStormPlayer.description: Supports Spells which create Storms, causing them to originate from the player and move towards the target location. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

SupportAftershockChancePlayer.name: Aftershock I
SupportAftershockChancePlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

SupportAftershockChancePlayerTwo.name: Aftershock II
SupportAftershockChancePlayerTwo.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, giving them a chance to create an Aftershock.

SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.name: Ahn's Citadel
SupportAhnsCitadelPlayer.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to instead be created along a fissure.

SupportAilithLineagePlayer.name: Ailith's Chimes
SupportAilithLineagePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.

SupportAlignmentPlayer.name: Alignment I
SupportAlignmentPlayer.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.name: Alignment III
SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.name: Alignment II
SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

SupportAmanamusTithePlayer.name: Amanamu's Tithe
SupportAmanamusTithePlayer.description: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.name: Ambrosia
SupportAmbrosiaPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

SupportAmbrosiaPlayerTwo.name: Ambrosia II
SupportAmbrosiaPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

SupportAmbushPlayer.name: Ambush
SupportAmbushPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Critically Hit enemies on full life.

SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.name: Ammo Conservation I
SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.name: Arjun's Medal
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.name: Ammo Conservation III
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.name: Ammo Conservation II
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.

SupportAncestralAidPlayer.name: Ancestral Aid
SupportAncestralAidPlayer.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

SupportAncestralCallPlayer.name: Ancestral Call I
SupportAncestralCallPlayer.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.name: Ancestral Call II
SupportAncestralCallPlayerTwo.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.name: Arakaali's Lust
SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.name: Arbiter's Ignition
SupportArbitersIgnitionPlayer.description: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.name: Arcane Surge
SupportArcaneSurgePlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

SupportArmourBreakPlayer.name: Armour Break I
SupportArmourBreakPlayer.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.name: Armour Break III
SupportArmourBreakPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.name: Armour Break II
SupportArmourBreakPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Break Armour based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt. On Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain an Endurance Charge.

SupportArmourDemolisherPlayer.name: Armour Demolisher I
SupportArmourDemolisherPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.name: Armour Demolisher II
SupportArmourDemolisherPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger.

SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.name: Armour Explosion
SupportArmourExplosionPlayer.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries, causing them to trigger a Fiery explosion when they Fully Break an enemy's Armour.

SupportArmsLengthPlayer.name: Arms Length
SupportArmsLengthPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.name: Astral Projection
SupportAstralProjectionPlayer.description: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.name: Atalui's Bloodletting
SupportAtaluiBloodlettingPlayer.description: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.name: Atziri's Allure
SupportAtzirisAllurePlayer.description: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.name: Atziri's Impatience
SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.description: Supports Skills with Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportAutoReloadPlayer.name: Auto Reload
SupportAutoReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

SupportBarbsPlayer.name: Barbs I
SupportBarbsPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

SupportBarbsPlayerThree.name: Barbs III
SupportBarbsPlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit twice after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.name: Barbs II
SupportBarbsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. Supported Skills deal your Thorns Damage on Hit after you've Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

SupportBattershoutPlayer.name: Battershout
SupportBattershoutPlayer.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

SupportBeheadPlayer.name: Behead I
SupportBeheadPlayer.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.name: Behead II
SupportBeheadPlayerTwo.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

SupportBhatairsVengeancePlayer.name: Bhatair's Vengeance
SupportBhatairsVengeancePlayer.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

SupportBiddingPlayer.name: Bidding I
SupportBiddingPlayer.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

SupportBiddingPlayerThree.name: Bidding III
SupportBiddingPlayerThree.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.name: Bidding II
SupportBiddingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

SupportBitingFrostPlayer.name: Biting Frost I
SupportBitingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

SupportBitingFrostPlayerTwo.name: Biting Frost II
SupportBitingFrostPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage to Frozen enemies but consume their Freeze, leaving them Chilled. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

SupportBlazingCriticalPlayer.name: Blazing Critical
SupportBlazingCriticalPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

SupportBleedPlayer.name: Bleed I
SupportBleedPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

SupportBleedPlayerFour.name: Bleed IV
SupportBleedPlayerFour.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

SupportBleedPlayerThree.name: Bleed III
SupportBleedPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

SupportBleedPlayerTwo.name: Bleed II
SupportBleedPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

SupportBlindPlayer.name: Blind I
SupportBlindPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

SupportBlindPlayerTwo.name: Blind II
SupportBlindPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

SupportBlindsidePlayer.name: Blindside
SupportBlindsidePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

SupportBloodFountainPlayer.name: Font of Blood
SupportBloodFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Blood which will Leech Life to Allies within it.

SupportBloodMagicPlayer.name: Lifetap
SupportBloodMagicPlayer.description: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

SupportBloodlustPlayer.name: Bloodlust
SupportBloodlustPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.name: Bone Shrapnel
SupportBoneShrapnelPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.name: Boundless Energy I
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.name: Boundless Energy II
SupportBoundlessEnergyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

SupportBountyPlayer.name: Bounty I
SupportBountyPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

SupportBountyPlayerTwo.name: Bounty II
SupportBountyPlayerTwo.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.

SupportBrambleslamPlayer.name: Brambleslam
SupportBrambleslamPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills create Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.name: Branching Fissures I
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.name: Branching Fissures II
SupportBranchingFissuresPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

SupportBrinkPlayer.name: Brink I
SupportBrinkPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.name: Brink II
SupportBrinkPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

SupportBrittleArmourPlayer.name: Brittle Armour
SupportBrittleArmourPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

SupportBrutalityPlayer.name: Brutality I
SupportBrutalityPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.name: Brutality III
SupportBrutalityPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.name: Brutality II
SupportBrutalityPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.name: Brutus' Brain
SupportBrutusBrainPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

SupportBurgeonPlayer.name: Burgeon I
SupportBurgeonPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.name: Burgeon II
SupportBurgeonPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

SupportBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription
SupportBurningRunesPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Runic Inscriptions when Cast, causing those Runic Inscriptions to trigger Burning Inscription when they expire. Burning Inscription is a Spell which creates Ignited Ground based off of your Maximum Mana.

SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.name: Bursting Plague
SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.description: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

SupportCadencePlayer.name: Cadence
SupportCadencePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

SupportCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops
SupportCaltropsPlayer.description: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.

SupportCannibalismPlayer.name: Cannibalism I
SupportCannibalismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.name: Cannibalism II
SupportCannibalismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to recover Life on kill while the Skill is active.

SupportCatalysingElementsPlayer.name: Catalysing Elements
SupportCatalysingElementsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.

SupportCatharsisPlayer.name: Catharsis
SupportCatharsisPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition. Does not support Triggered Skills.

SupportChainPlayer.name: Chain I
SupportChainPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

SupportChainPlayerThree.name: Chain III
SupportChainPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

SupportChainPlayerTwo.name: Chain II
SupportChainPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.name: Chaos Mastery
SupportChaosMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Chaos skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.name: Chaotic Freeze
SupportChaoticFreezePlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time. Enemies taking damage over time from Debuffs caused by supported skills will suffer Freeze build up from Chaos damage Hits from any source. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.name: Inhibitor
SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself or that you Trigger. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.name: Charge Profusion I
SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.

SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.name: Charge Profusion II
SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.

SupportChargedMarkPlayer.name: Charged Mark
SupportChargedMarkPlayer.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

SupportChargedShotsPlayer.name: Charged Shots I
SupportChargedShotsPlayer.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.name: Charged Shots II
SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

SupportCharmBountyPlayer.name: Charm Bounty
SupportCharmBountyPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

SupportChillingIcePlayer.name: Frost Nexus
SupportChillingIcePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.name: Cirel's Cultivation
SupportCirelsCultivationPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

SupportClarityPlayer.name: Clarity I
SupportClarityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

SupportClarityPlayerTwo.name: Clarity II
SupportClarityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Mana Regeneration while the Skill is active.

SupportClashPlayer.name: Clash
SupportClashPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

SupportCloseCombatPlayer.name: Close Combat I
SupportCloseCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.name: Close Combat II
SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

SupportColdExposurePlayer.name: Cold Exposure
SupportColdExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when it Critically Hits an enemy.

SupportColdMasteryPlayer.name: Cold Mastery
SupportColdMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Cold skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.name: Cold Penetration
SupportColdPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

SupportCombatReloadPlayer.name: Ratha's Assault
SupportCombatReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.

SupportComboFinisherPlayer.name: Combo Finisher I
SupportComboFinisherPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo, or Triggered Skills.

SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.name: Combo Finisher II
SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo, or Triggered Skills.

SupportCommandment.name: Commandment
SupportCommandment.description: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

SupportCommiseratePlayer.name: Commiserate
SupportCommiseratePlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself or Trigger, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.name: Concentrated Area
SupportConcentratedAreaPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

SupportConcoctPlayer.name: Concoct I
SupportConcoctPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.name: Concoct II
SupportConcoctPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

SupportConcussiveSpellsPlayer.name: Concussive Spells
SupportConcussiveSpellsPlayer.description: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.name: Considered Casting
SupportConsideredCastingPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.name: Controlled Destruction
SupportControlledDestructionPlayer.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

SupportControlledHazardPlayer.name: Controlled Hazard
SupportControlledHazardPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.name: Cooldown Recovery I
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.name: Cooldown Recovery II
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.

SupportCoolheadedPlayer.name: Cool Headed
SupportCoolheadedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.name: Corpse Conservation
SupportCorpseConservationPlayer.description: Supports skills that consume Corpses, giving them a chance to take effect without destroying the Corpse.

SupportCorrosionPlayer.name: Corrosion
SupportCorrosionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.name: Corrupting Cry I
SupportCorruptingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.name: Paquate's Pact
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerThree.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict massive amounts of Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect, at the cost of your Life.

SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.name: Corrupting Cry II
SupportCorruptingCryPlayerTwo.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to inflict Corrupted Blood on enemies in their area of effect.

SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.name: Crackling Barrier
SupportCracklingBarrierPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

SupportCraterPlayer.name: Crater
SupportCraterPlayer.description: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.name: Crazed Minions
SupportCrazedMinionsPlayer.description: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

SupportCreepingChillPlayer.name: Creeping Chill
SupportCreepingChillPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

SupportCrescendoPlayer.name: Crescendo I
SupportCrescendoPlayer.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession.

SupportCrescendoPlayerThree.name: Crescendo III
SupportCrescendoPlayerThree.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to be Ancestrally Boosted.

SupportCrescendoPlayerTwo.name: Crescendo II
SupportCrescendoPlayerTwo.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, allowing you to use the Final Strike twice in succession, and causing Non-Final Strike Attacks to be faster.

SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.name: Crystalline Shards
SupportCrystallineShardsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

SupportCullingStrikePlayer.name: Culling Strike I
SupportCullingStrikePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.

SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.name: Culling Strike II
SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.

SupportCulminationPlayer.name: Culmination I
SupportCulminationPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.name: Culmination II
SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportCurseEffectPlayer.name: Heightened Curse
SupportCurseEffectPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills, magnifying their power.

SupportCursedGroundPlayer.name: Cursed Ground
SupportCursedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse Enemies so long as they are within them.

SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.name: Danse Macabre
SupportDanseMacabrePlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.name: Daresso's Passion
SupportDaressosPassionPlayer.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

SupportDauntlessPlayer.name: Dauntless
SupportDauntlessPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a reservation, are Triggered, have a cooldown or have another usage Condition.

SupportDazePlayer.name: Daze
SupportDazePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

SupportDazedBreakPlayer.name: Break Posture
SupportDazedBreakPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Daze Enemies when they fully Break Armour.

SupportDazingCryPlayer.name: Dazing Cry
SupportDazingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to Daze Enemies on use.

SupportDazzlePlayer.name: Dazzle
SupportDazzlePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills always hit Dazed Enemies, but Consume Daze on Hit, and cannot themselves inflict Daze.

SupportDeadlyCurrentPlayer.name: Coursing Current
SupportDeadlyCurrentPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.name: Deadly Herald
SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.description: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.name: Searing Flame I
SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayerTwo.name: Searing Flame II
SupportDeadlyIgnitesPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.name: Deadly Poison I
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.name: Deadly Poison II
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.

SupportDeathmarchPlayer.name: Deathmarch
SupportDeathmarchPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

SupportDecayingHexPlayer.name: Decaying Hex
SupportDecayingHexPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills. Cursed enemies' bodies decay, taking Chaos damage over time.

SupportDeepCutsPlayer.name: Deep Cuts I
SupportDeepCutsPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.name: Deep Cuts II
SupportDeepCutsPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Bleeding.

SupportDefyPlayer.name: Defy I
SupportDefyPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

SupportDefyPlayerTwo.name: Defy II
SupportDefyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.name: Delayed Gratification
SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.description: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.name: Delayed Reaction
SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

SupportDeliberationPlayer.name: Deliberation
SupportDeliberationPlayer.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

SupportDerangePlayer.name: Derange
SupportDerangePlayer.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

SupportDesperationPlayer.name: Desperation
SupportDesperationPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used while Surrounded.

SupportDevastatePlayer.name: Devastate
SupportDevastatePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to apply Broken Armour to enemies when causing a Heavy Stun to enemies.

SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.name: Dialla's Desire
SupportDiallasDesirePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

SupportDirestrikePlayer.name: Direstrike I
SupportDirestrikePlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportDirestrikePlayerTwo.name: Direstrike II
SupportDirestrikePlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportDoedresUndoingPlayer.name: Doedre's Undoing
SupportDoedresUndoingPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create Hazardous areas which explode when Enemies enter them, Cursing Enemies and dealing Chaos Damage.

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.name: Double Barrel I
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerThree.name: Double Barrel III
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerThree.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed. Supported Skills will also automatically reload when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.name: Double Barrel II
SupportDoubleBarrelPlayerTwo.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load an extra bolt at the cost of reload speed.

SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.name: Drain Ailments
SupportDrainedAilmentPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to consume Ailments on enemies it applies damage over time Debuffs to in order to deal substantially more damage over time.

SupportDurabilityPlayer.name: Durability
SupportDurabilityPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportEchoingCryPlayer.name: Echoing Cry
SupportEchoingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills echo, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay, growing larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

SupportEfficiencyPlayer.name: Efficiency I
SupportEfficiencyPlayer.description: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

SupportEfficiencyPlayerTwo.name: Efficiency II
SupportEfficiencyPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.name: Einhar's Beastrite
SupportEinharsBeastritePlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportElectrocutePlayer.name: Electrocute
SupportElectrocutePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.

SupportElementalArmamentPlayer.name: Elemental Armament I
SupportElementalArmamentPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

SupportElementalArmamentPlayerThree.name: Elemental Armament III
SupportElementalArmamentPlayerThree.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they Hit. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.name: Elemental Armament II
SupportElementalArmamentPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more Elemental damage.

SupportElementalArmyPlayer.name: Elemental Army
SupportElementalArmyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

SupportElementalDischargePlayer.name: Elemental Discharge
SupportElementalDischargePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to consume Elemental Ailments on hit to trigger an Elemental Discharge. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

SupportElementalFocusPlayer.name: Elemental Focus
SupportElementalFocusPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

SupportEmbitterPlayer.name: Embitter
SupportEmbitterPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.name: Murderous Intent
SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.description: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.

SupportEmpoweredDamagePlayer.name: Premeditation
SupportEmpoweredDamagePlayer.description: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to deal more damage.

SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.name: Encroaching Ground
SupportEncroachingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

SupportEnduranceChargeOnArmourBreak.name: Break Endurance
SupportEnduranceChargeOnArmourBreak.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when it Fully Breaks an enemy's Armour.

SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.name: Energy Barrier
SupportEnergyBarrierPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, causing Energy Shield recharge to begin immediately if you are Stunned while using it.

SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.name: Energy Capacitor
SupportEnergyCapacitorPlayer.description: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.name: Energy Retention
SupportEnergyRetentionPlayer.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.name: Shock Siphon
SupportEnergyShieldOnShockKillPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.name: Enraged Warcry I
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.name: Enraged Warcry II
SupportEnragedWarcryPlayerTwo.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.name: Escalating Poison
SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.

SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.name: Esh's Radiance
SupportEshsRadiancePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.name: Essence Harvest
SupportEssenceHarvestPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

SupportEternalMarkPlayer.name: Eternal Mark
SupportEternalMarkPlayer.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

SupportExcisePlayer.name: Excise
SupportExcisePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

SupportExcoriatePlayer.name: Excoriate
SupportExcoriatePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Melee Damage for each Elemental Ailment on Enemies they hit, but cannot themselves inflict Elemental Ailments.

SupportExecratePlayer.name: Execrate
SupportExecratePlayer.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

SupportExecutePlayer.name: Execute I
SupportExecutePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

SupportExecutePlayerThree.name: Execute III
SupportExecutePlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

SupportExecutePlayerTwo.name: Execute II
SupportExecutePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

SupportExpandPlayer.name: Expand
SupportExpandPlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, increasing their area of effect when cast. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.

SupportExpansePlayer.name: Expanse
SupportExpansePlayer.description: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.name: Exploit Weakness
SupportExploitWeaknessPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayer.name: Accelerated Growth
SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayer.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.name: Accelerated Growth II
SupportExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

SupportExposingCryPlayer.name: Exposing Cry
SupportExposingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

SupportExtractionPlayer.name: Extraction
SupportExtractionPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

SupportFanTheFlamesPlayer.name: Fan The Flames
SupportFanTheFlamesPlayer.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.name: Fan The Flames II
SupportFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

SupportFarCombatPlayer.name: Longshot I
SupportFarCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.name: Longshot II
SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.

SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.name: Feeding Frenzy I
SupportFeedingFrenzyPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

SupportFerocityPlayer.name: Ferocity
SupportFerocityPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Frenzy Charges.

SupportFieryDeathPlayer.name: Fiery Death
SupportFieryDeathPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it Ignites to have a chance to explode on death.

SupportFireExposurePlayer.name: Fire Exposure
SupportFireExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when Igniting.

SupportFireMasteryPlayer.name: Fire Mastery
SupportFireMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Fire skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.name: Fire Penetration I
SupportFirePenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.name: Fire Penetration II
SupportFirePenetrationPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

SupportFirstBloodPlayer.name: First Blood
SupportFirstBloodPlayer.description: Supports Attacks. Supported Skills are far more likely to inflict Bleeding on Hitting full Life Enemies.

SupportFlamePillarPlayer.name: Flame Pillar
SupportFlamePillarPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportFlamepiercePlayer.name: Flamepierce
SupportFlamepiercePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.name: Harmonic Remnants I
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.name: Harmonic Remnants II
SupportFleetingRemnantsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

SupportFlowPlayer.name: Flow
SupportFlowPlayer.description: Supports Skills which require Combo to use. Supported Skills lose their Combo stacks after a longer delay spent not gaining any Combo.

SupportFlukePlayer.name: Fluke
SupportFlukePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

SupportFlukePlayerTwo.name: Ixchel's Torment
SupportFlukePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

SupportFocusedCursePlayer.name: Focused Curse
SupportFocusedCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to Curse enemies more quickly after being cast.

SupportForkPlayer.name: Fork
SupportForkPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

SupportFreezePlayer.name: Freeze
SupportFreezePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

SupportFreezeforkPlayer.name: Freezefork
SupportFreezeforkPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.name: Frenzied Riposte
SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself or that you Trigger, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

SupportFreshClipPlayer.name: Fresh Clip I
SupportFreshClipPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 6 seconds.

SupportFreshClipPlayerTwo.name: Fresh Clip II
SupportFreshClipPlayerTwo.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, granting them more damage for each bolt reloaded by that Skill in the last 8 seconds.

SupportFrostfirePlayer.name: Frostfire
SupportFrostfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Consume Freeze on Igniting a Frozen enemy to boost the effect of the Ignite.

SupportFrozenSpitePlayer.name: Frozen Spite
SupportFrozenSpitePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportGambleshotPlayer.name: Gambleshot
SupportGambleshotPlayer.description: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.name: Garukhan's Resolve
SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance. Cannot support Skills which have a Cooldown or that are Triggered, and does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportGlacierPlayer.name: Glacier
SupportGlacierPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

SupportGuatelitzisAblationPlayer.name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
SupportGuatelitzisAblationPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.name: Haemocrystals
SupportHaemocrystalsPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.name: Hardy Totems I
SupportHardyTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.name: Tawhoa's Tending
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Hardy Totems II
SupportHardyTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

SupportHayoxisBindingPlayer.name: Hayoxi's Fulmination
SupportHayoxisBindingPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Supported Curse Skills create areas which Curse enemies so long as they are within them. Cursed areas from Supported Skills gather power before erupting in a column of annihilating light after a moderate delay.

SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerOne.name: Enduring Impact I
SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerOne.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.name: Enduring Impact II
SupportHeavyStunEndurancePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

SupportHeftPlayer.name: Heft
SupportHeftPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.name: Heightened Accuracy I
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.name: Heightened Accuracy II
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.name: Heightened Charges
SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

SupportHerbalismPlayer.name: Herbalism I
SupportHerbalismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.name: Herbalism II
SupportHerbalismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Life recovery from Flasks while the Skill is active.

SupportHexBloomPlayer.name: Hex Bloom
SupportHexBloomPlayer.description: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

SupportHinderPlayer.name: Hinder
SupportHinderPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment Chaos damage over time, causing damage over time they inflict to also Hinder enemies. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

SupportHitAndRunPlayer.name: Hit and Run
SupportHitAndRunPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a Cooldown or that are Triggered, and does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportHobblePlayer.name: Hobble
SupportHobblePlayer.description: Supports Skills that Hit Enemies, causing those Hits to Hobble Bleeding Enemies based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.

SupportHolyDescentPlayer.name: Holy Descent
SupportHolyDescentPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Consecrated Ground when you land.

SupportHourglassPlayer.name: Hourglass
SupportHourglassPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal significantly more damage but gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.name: Hulking Minions
SupportHulkingMinionsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

SupportIceBitePlayer.name: Ice Bite I
SupportIceBitePlayer.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses all of your Attacks with Cold damage for a short time.

SupportIceBitePlayerTwo.name: Ice Bite II
SupportIceBitePlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses all of your Attacks with Cold damage for a short time.

SupportIciclePlayer.name: Icicle
SupportIciclePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.name: Eternal Flame I
SupportIgniteDurationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.name: Eternal Flame III
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.name: Eternal Flame II
SupportIgniteDurationPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

SupportIgnitePlayer.name: Ignite I
SupportIgnitePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

SupportIgnitePlayerThree.name: Ignite III
SupportIgnitePlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.name: Ignite II
SupportIgnitePlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

SupportImmolatePlayer.name: Immolate
SupportImmolatePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

SupportImpalePlayer.name: Impale
SupportImpalePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

SupportIncisionPlayer.name: Incision
SupportIncisionPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.name: Overabundance I
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.description: Supports skills which can have a Limited number of effects active at once, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.name: Overabundance II
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which can have a Limited number of effects active at once, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".

SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.name: Supercritical
SupportIncreasedCriticalDamagePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.name: Inexorable Critical I
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayer.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayerTwo.name: Inexorable Critical II
SupportInevitableCriticalsPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.name: Infernal Legion I
SupportInfernalLegionPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.name: Infernal Legion III
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerThree.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.

SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.name: Infernal Legion II
SupportInfernalLegionPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Burn. Damage dealt by the Burning is based off the Life of the supported Minion.

SupportInnervatePlayer.name: Innervate
SupportInnervatePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.name: Intense Agony
SupportIntenseAgonyPlayer.description: Supports Spells that deal non-Ailment damage over time, causing them to have a shorter duration but deal substantially more damage over time with Debuffs inflicted against enemies on full life.

SupportInterludePlayer.name: Remnant Potency I
SupportInterludePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

SupportInterludePlayerThree.name: Remnant Potency III
SupportInterludePlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

SupportInterludePlayerTwo.name: Remnant Potency II
SupportInterludePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.name: Jagged Ground I
SupportJaggedGroundPlayer.description: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground.

SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.name: Jagged Ground II
SupportJaggedGroundPlayerTwo.description: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.name: Kalisa's Crescendo
SupportKalisasCrescendoPlayer.description: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.name: Kaom's Madness
SupportKaomsMadnessPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

SupportKhatalsRejuvenationPlayer.name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
SupportKhatalsRejuvenationPlayer.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

SupportKnockbackPlayer.name: Knockback
SupportKnockbackPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.name: Wind Wave
SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.

SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.name: Kulemak's Dominion
SupportKulemaksDominionPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills, causing Spells that affect an area around you or a target location to also affect the area around Supported Offerings.

SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.name: Kurgal's Leash
SupportKurgalsLeashPlayer.description: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

SupportLastGaspPlayer.name: Last Gasp
SupportLastGaspPlayer.description: Supports skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a short duration or when they take further damage exceeding their maximum Life.

SupportLastingFrostPlayer.name: Deep Freeze
SupportLastingFrostPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

SupportLastingGroundPlayer.name: Lasting Ground
SupportLastingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

SupportLastingShockPlayer.name: Lasting Shock
SupportLastingShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

SupportLeveragePlayer.name: Leverage
SupportLeveragePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills gain increased chance to Critically Hit against Immobilised Enemies.

SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.name: Life Bounty
SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.

SupportLifeLeechPlayer.name: Life Leech I
SupportLifeLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.name: Life Leech III
SupportLifeLeechPlayerThree.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.name: Life Leech II
SupportLifeLeechPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.name: Life Drain
SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.

SupportLightningExposurePlayer.name: Lightning Exposure
SupportLightningExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.

SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.name: Lightning Mastery
SupportLightningMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Lightning skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.name: Lightning Penetration
SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

SupportLivingLightningPlayer.name: Living Lightning
SupportLivingLightningPlayer.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.name: Living Lightning II
SupportLivingLightningPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportLockdownPlayer.name: Lockdown
SupportLockdownPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.

SupportLongFusePlayer.name: Long Fuse I
SupportLongFusePlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.name: Long Fuse II
SupportLongFusePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

SupportLoyaltyPlayer.name: Loyalty
SupportLoyaltyPlayer.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.name: Magnetic Remnants
SupportMagneticRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.name: Magnified Area I
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayer.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.name: Magnified Area II
SupportMagnifiedAreaPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

SupportMaimPlayer.name: Maim
SupportMaimPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

SupportMaladyPlayer.name: Malady
SupportMaladyPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleed with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleed.

SupportManaFlarePlayer.name: Mana Flare
SupportManaFlarePlayer.description: Supports any Spell that Hits enemies, causing it to trigger a Mana Flare on Critical Hit. The Mana Flare consumes your Mana to deal Fire damage. Cannot support the skills of Minions.

SupportManaFlaskPlayer.name: Mana Bounty
SupportManaFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.

SupportManaFountainPlayer.name: Font of Mana
SupportManaFountainPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by supported Skills generate a Font of Mana which will Leech Mana to Allies within it.

SupportManaLeechPlayer.name: Mana Leech
