SupportManaLeechPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

SupportManaOnCullPlayer.name: Soul Drain
SupportManaOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.

SupportMarkForDeathPlayer.name: Mark for Death
SupportMarkForDeathPlayer.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.name: Mark for Death II
SupportMarkForDeathPlayerTwo.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayer.name: Mark of Siphoning
SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayer.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayerTwo.name: Mark of Siphoning II
SupportMarkOfSiphoningPlayerTwo.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

SupportMeatShieldPlayer.name: Meat Shield I
SupportMeatShieldPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

SupportMeatShieldPlayerTwo.name: Meat Shield II
SupportMeatShieldPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.name: Heavy Swing
SupportMeleePhysicalDamagePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.name: Minion Instability
SupportMinionInstabilityPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing them to violently explode when reduced to Low Life.

SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.name: Minion Mastery
SupportMinionMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Minion skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportMinionPactPlayer.name: Minion Pact I
SupportMinionPactPlayer.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.name: Minion Pact II
SupportMinionPactPlayerTwo.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself, draining the life from one of your Minions on use in order to boost the skill's damage. Only takes effect if you have a Minion with enough life to drain the full amount.

SupportMobilityPlayer.name: Mobility
SupportMobilityPlayer.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.

SupportMomentumPlayer.name: Momentum
SupportMomentumPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

SupportMorganasTempestPlayer.name: Morgana's Tempest
SupportMorganasTempestPlayer.description: Supports Spells which create Storms, increasing their Limit and causing them to move from the player towards the target location faster, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

SupportMultishotPlayer.name: Multishot I
SupportMultishotPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.name: Multishot II
SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

SupportMusterPlayer.name: Muster
SupportMusterPlayer.description: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

SupportMysticismPlayer.name: Mysticism I
SupportMysticismPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.name: Mysticism II
SupportMysticismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportNadirPlayer.name: Nadir
SupportNadirPlayer.description: Supports Skills which gain Stages or Seals. Supported Skills have lower Maximum Stage or Seal count, but have a Minimum Stage or Seal count they cannot fall below.

SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.name: Neural Overload
SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.name: Nimble Reload
SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.

SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.name: Nova Projectiles I
SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.name: Nova Projectiles II
SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

SupportOisinsOathPlayer.name: Oisín's Oath
SupportOisinsOathPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

SupportOpeningMovePlayer.name: Opening Move
SupportOpeningMovePlayer.description: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

SupportOutmaneuverPlayer.name: Outmaneuver
SupportOutmaneuverPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Break Armour against Parried Enemies.

SupportOverchargePlayer.name: Overcharge
SupportOverchargePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

SupportOverextendPlayer.name: Overextend
SupportOverextendPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

SupportOverreachPlayer.name: Overreach
SupportOverreachPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

SupportPayloadPlayer.name: Payload
SupportPayloadPlayer.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.name: Perfected Endurance
SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

SupportPerfectionPlayer.name: Perfection
SupportPerfectionPlayer.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.name: Perpetual Charge
SupportPerpetualChargePlayer.description: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

SupportPersistentGroundPlayer.name: Persistent Ground I
SupportPersistentGroundPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

SupportPersistentGroundPlayerThree.name: Persistent Ground III
SupportPersistentGroundPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.name: Persistent Ground II
SupportPersistentGroundPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.name: Physical Mastery
SupportPhysicalMasteryPlayer.description: Supports Physical skills, granting them an additional level. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportPiercePlayer.name: Pierce I
SupportPiercePlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

SupportPiercePlayerThree.name: Pierce III
SupportPiercePlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

SupportPiercePlayerTwo.name: Pierce II
SupportPiercePlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

SupportPietysMercyPlayer.name: Dominus' Grasp
SupportPietysMercyPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

SupportPinPlayer.name: Pin I
SupportPinPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.

SupportPinPlayerThree.name: Pin III
SupportPinPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.

SupportPinPlayerTwo.name: Pin II
SupportPinPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.

SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.name: Pinpoint Critical
SupportPinpointCriticalPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

SupportPoisonPlayer.name: Poison I
SupportPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

SupportPoisonPlayerThree.name: Poison III
SupportPoisonPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.name: Poison II
SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

SupportPoisonSpores.name: Poison Spores
SupportPoisonSpores.description: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.

SupportPotentExposurePlayer.name: Potent Exposure
SupportPotentExposurePlayer.description: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

SupportPotentialPlayer.name: Potential
SupportPotentialPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Power Charge on use if possible, and will be much more likely to Critically Hit if they do. Supported Skills cannot generate Power Charges.

SupportPracticalMagicPlayer.name: Practical Magic I
SupportPracticalMagicPlayer.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

SupportPracticalMagicPlayerTwo.name: Practical Magic II
SupportPracticalMagicPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

SupportPracticedComboPlayer.name: Practiced Combo
SupportPracticedComboPlayer.description: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

SupportPrecisionPlayer.name: Precision I
SupportPrecisionPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.name: Precision II
SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.

SupportProfanityPlayer.name: Profanity I
SupportProfanityPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do. Cannot support Triggered Skills or Reservation Skills.

SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.name: Profanity II
SupportProfanityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed. Cannot support Triggered Skills or Reservation Skills.

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.name: Projectile Acceleration I
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.name: Projectile Acceleration III
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.name: Projectile Acceleration II
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.name: Projectile Deceleration I
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.name: Projectile Deceleration II
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

SupportPunchThroughPlayer.name: Punch Through
SupportPunchThroughPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

SupportPursuitPlayer.name: Pursuit I
SupportPursuitPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

SupportPursuitPlayerThree.name: Pursuit III
SupportPursuitPlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.name: Pursuit II
SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

SupportQuillburstPlayer.name: Quill Burst
SupportQuillburstPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've\nRetaliated with Thorns Damage.

SupportRagePlayer.name: Rage I
SupportRagePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

SupportRagePlayerThree.name: Rage III
SupportRagePlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you are not at maximum Rage.

SupportRagePlayerTwo.name: Rage II
SupportRagePlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

SupportRageforgedPlayer.name: Rageforged I
SupportRageforgedPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.name: Rageforged II
SupportRageforgedPlayerTwo.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use or trigger yourself, causing it to spend Rage to deal more damage, with a chance to skip spending Rage while still benefitting as though it had. If you don't have enough Rage to spend, the damage bonus will not apply.

SupportRagingCryPlayer.name: Raging Cry
SupportRagingCryPlayer.description: Supports Warcry skills, causing them to grant you Rage on use depending on counted monster Power.

SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.name: Rakiata's Flow
SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

SupportRallyPlayer.name: Rally
SupportRallyPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills Consume all Endurance Charge on use, causing you to restore a percentage of your maximum Life for each Charge Consumed.

SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.name: Rapid Attacks I
SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.name: Rapid Attacks III
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.name: Rapid Attacks II
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

SupportRapidCastingPlayer.name: Rapid Casting I
SupportRapidCastingPlayer.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.name: Rapid Casting III
SupportRapidCastingPlayerThree.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast Recently.

SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.name: Rapid Casting II
SupportRapidCastingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

SupportRearmPlayer.name: Rearm I
SupportRearmPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

SupportRearmPlayerTwo.name: Rearm II
SupportRearmPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

SupportRefractionPlayer.name: Refraction I
SupportRefractionPlayer.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

SupportRefractionPlayerThree.name: Refraction III
SupportRefractionPlayerThree.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.name: Refraction II
SupportRefractionPlayerTwo.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.name: Reinforced Totems I
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Reinforced Totems II
SupportReinforcedTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.name: Relentless Rage
SupportRelentlessRagePlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

SupportRendingApexPlayer.name: Rending Apex
SupportRendingApexPlayer.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

SupportRetaliatePlayer.name: Retaliate I
SupportRetaliatePlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.name: Retaliate II
SupportRetaliatePlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

SupportRetreatPlayer.name: Retreat I
SupportRetreatPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

SupportRetreatPlayerThree.name: Retreat III
SupportRetreatPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.name: Retreat II
SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

SupportReveberatePlayer.name: Reverberate
SupportReveberatePlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

SupportRicochetPlayer.name: Ricochet I
SupportRicochetPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.name: Ricochet II
SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.name: Rigwald's Ferocity
SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.description: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

SupportRimePlayer.name: Rime
SupportRimePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing Enemies Chilled by those Surfaces to be more easily Frozen, but at the cost of some Chill magnitude.

SupportRipPlayer.name: Rip
SupportRipPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself or that you Trigger. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.name: Ritualistic Curse
SupportRitualisticCursePlayer.description: Supports Curse skills, causing them to cover a larger area but take longer to Curse enemies.

SupportRupturePlayer.name: Rupture
SupportRupturePlayer.description: Supports skills that Hit Enemies. Supported skills Aggravate Bleeding on Hitting Heavily Stunned Enemies.

SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.name: Rusted Spikes
SupportRustedSpikesPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.name: Sacrificial Offering
SupportSacrificalOfferingPlayer.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.name: Sacrificial Lamb I
SupportSacrificialLambPlayer.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing your skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill.

SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.name: Sacrificial Lamb II
SupportSacrificialLambPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing your skills which can target Minions to prioritise targeting Minions from the Supported Skill, as well as causing them to always be considered Detonatable.

SupportSalvoPlayer.name: Salvo
SupportSalvoPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles. Supported Skills accumulate Seals over time, and consume them when used. For each Seal consumed, the Attack will fire additional Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or already gain Seals.

SupportSecondWindPlayer.name: Second Wind I
SupportSecondWindPlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.name: Second Wind III
SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.name: Second Wind II
SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

SupportSeeRedPlayer.name: See Red
SupportSeeRedPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Bleeding inflicted with Supported Skills lasts significantly longer, but enemies you inflict Bleeding onto with Supported Skills will move and Attack faster.

SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.name: Selfless Remnants
SupportSelflessRemnantsPlayer.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

SupportShockConductionPlayer.name: Shock Conduction I
SupportShockConductionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

SupportShockConductionPlayerTwo.name: Shock Conduction II
SupportShockConductionPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

SupportShockPlayer.name: Shock
SupportShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

SupportShockingLeapPlayer.name: Shocking Leap
SupportShockingLeapPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

SupportShockingRiftPlayer.name: Electromagnetism
SupportShockingRiftPlayer.description: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.

SupportShortFusePlayer.name: Short Fuse I
SupportShortFusePlayer.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.name: Short Fuse II
SupportShortFusePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.name: Skittering Stone I
SupportSkitteringStonePlayer.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.name: Skittering Stone II
SupportSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.name: Tectonic Slams
SupportSlamAftershocksPlayer.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, causing them to create simultaneous Aftershocks behind the Slam, but lowering Aftershock damage and area of effect with Supported Skills. Cannot Support Skills which create Fissures.

SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.name: Slow Potency
SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.

SupportSparPlayer.name: Spar
SupportSparPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.name: Spectral Volley
SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.description: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

SupportSpellCascadePlayer.name: Spell Cascade
SupportSpellCascadePlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location, causing those Spells to also target additional areas on either side of the target area, along a randomly chosen axis. Cannot support Channelling skills or Remote skills.

SupportSpellEchoPlayer.name: Spell Echo
SupportSpellEchoPlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay. Cannot support Channelling skills Remote skills or skills which are Triggered.

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.name: Splinter Totem I
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.name: Splinter Totem II
SupportSplinteringTotemPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

SupportStaticShocksPlayer.name: Static Shocks
SupportStaticShocksPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.

SupportSteadfastPlayer.name: Steadfast I
SupportSteadfastPlayer.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.name: Steadfast II
SupportSteadfastPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

SupportStoicismPlayer.name: Stoicism I
SupportStoicismPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.name: Stoicism II
SupportStoicismPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

SupportStompingGroundPlayer.name: Stomping Ground
SupportStompingGroundPlayer.description: Supports Travel skills, causing your footsteps to crack the earth and emit damaging shockwaves while using the skill.

SupportStormchainPlayer.name: Stormchain
SupportStormchainPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

SupportStormfirePlayer.name: Stormfire
SupportStormfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Enemies Shocked by Supported Skills take a percentage of damage from Ignite as Lightning damage as well as Fire damage.

SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.name: Streamlined Rounds
SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.name: Strong Hearted
SupportStrongHeartedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportStunPlayer.name: Stun I
SupportStunPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

SupportStunPlayerThree.name: Stun III
SupportStunPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun significantly more quickly, at the cost of Damage.

SupportStunPlayerTwo.name: Stun II
SupportStunPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to build up Stun more quickly.

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.name: Swift Affliction I
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.name: Swift Affliction III
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.name: Swift Affliction II
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.

SupportSyzygyPlayer.name: Syzygy
SupportSyzygyPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

SupportTacatisIrePlayer.name: Tacati's Ire
SupportTacatisIrePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.

SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.name: Tasalio's Rhythm
SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

SupportTearPlayer.name: Tear
SupportTearPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself or that you Trigger. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.name: Tecrod's Revenge
SupportTecrodsRevengePlayer.description: Supports skills that create Persistent Minions, causing those Minions to fight on when they are fatally wounded, dying after a duration or when they take further damage exceeding their maximum Life. Minions from Supported Skills gain Soul Eater and a burst of speed on entering this state.

SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.name: Rising Tempest
SupportTempestuousTempoPlayer.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

SupportThornskinPlayer.name: Thornskin I
SupportThornskinPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.name: Thornskin II
SupportThornskinPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayer.name: Thrill of the Kill
SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayerTwo.name: Thrill of the Kill II
SupportThrillOfTheKillPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

SupportTirelessPlayer.name: Tireless
SupportTirelessPlayer.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

SupportTremorsPlayer.name: Tremors
SupportTremorsPlayer.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain multiple independent chances to cause Aftershocks, but deal less Damage.

SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.name: Tul's Stillness
SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

SupportTumultPlayer.name: Tumult
SupportTumultPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills consume a Frenzy Charge on use to powerfully Break Armour.

SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.name: Uhtred's Augury
SupportUhtredAuguryPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.name: Uhtred's Exodus
SupportUhtredExodusPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.name: Uhtred's Omen
SupportUhtredOmenPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

SupportUnabatingPlayer.name: Unabating
SupportUnabatingPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Armour, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

SupportUnbendingPlayer.name: Unbending
SupportUnbendingPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Mana, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Cast time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

SupportUnderminePlayer.name: Undermine
SupportUnderminePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.name: Unerring Power
SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

SupportUnleashPlayer.name: Unleash
SupportUnleashPlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, making their effect reoccur when cast. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.

SupportUnsteadyTempoPlayer.name: Unsteady Tempo
SupportUnsteadyTempoPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Attacking with Supported Skills will cycle through various effects, with the first Attack in sequence inflicting Hobble on you. The second and third Attacks in sequence will powerfully scale chance to Critically Hit and overall damage, respectively, at which point the cycle will reset. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

SupportUntouchablePlayer.name: Untouchable
SupportUntouchablePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

SupportUnyieldingPlayer.name: Unyielding
SupportUnyieldingPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, a percentage of Damage taken is Recouped as Life, with the percentage scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the Supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

SupportUpheavalPlayer.name: Upheaval I
SupportUpheavalPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.name: Upheaval II
SupportUpheavalPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

SupportUpwellingPlayer.name: Upwelling I
SupportUpwellingPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.name: Upwelling II
SupportUpwellingPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.name: Urgent Totems I
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.name: Urgent Totems III
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.name: Urgent Totems II
SupportUrgentTotemsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.name: Uruk's Smelting
SupportUruksSmeltingPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing Armour Break it inflicts to be stronger. Fully Breaking Armour with Supported Skills permanently increases the Physical Damage taken by those affected, up to a cap.

SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.name: Uul-Netol's Embrace
SupportUulNetolsEmbracePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

SupportVanguardPlayer.name: Vanguard I
SupportVanguardPlayer.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.name: Vanguard II
SupportVanguardPlayerTwo.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.name: Varashta's Blessing
SupportVarashtasBlessingPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that can deal Damage, causing it to deal more Damage per different Command Skill used.

SupportVerglasPlayer.name: Verglas
SupportVerglasPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.name: Vilenta's Propulsion
SupportVilentasPropulsionPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

SupportVitalityPlayer.name: Vitality I
SupportVitalityPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.name: Vitality II
SupportVitalityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain Life Regeneration while the Skill is active.

SupportVolatilePowerPlayer.name: Volatile Power
SupportVolatilePowerPlayer.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself. On using Supported Skills while they are Empowered, you gain Volatility.

SupportVolatilityPlayer.name: Volatility
SupportVolatilityPlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption
SupportVolcanicEruptionPlayer.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.

SupportVoltPlayer.name: Volt
SupportVoltPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

SupportWallFortressPlayer.name: Fortress I
SupportWallFortressPlayer.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage.

SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.name: Fortress II
SupportWallFortressPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills that create walls in a line, causing them to be created in a circle instead but deal less Hit damage and have lowered Area of Effect.

SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.name: Warm Blooded
SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

SupportWildfirePlayer.name: Wildfire
SupportWildfirePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

SupportWildshardsPlayer.name: Wildshards I
SupportWildshardsPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.name: Sione's Temper
SupportWildshardsPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.name: Wildshards II
SupportWildshardsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.name: Window of Opportunity I
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.name: Window of Opportunity II
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.

SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.name: Withering Touch
SupportWitheringTouchPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

SupportXibaquasRendingPlayer.name: Xibaqua's Rending
SupportXibaquasRendingPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

SupportXophsPyrePlayer.name: Xoph's Pyre
SupportXophsPyrePlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.name: Zarokh's Refrain
SupportZarokhsRefrainPlayer.description: Supports Spells that affect an area around you or a target location. Supported Spells echo thrice, causing their effects to happen again after a short delay, but Supported Skills are given a short Cooldown. Cannot support Channelling skills, Remote skills, skills which already have a Cooldown, or skills which are Triggered.

SupportZarokhsRevoltPlayer.name: Zarokh's Revolt
SupportZarokhsRevoltPlayer.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, making their effect reoccur up to five times when cast, but giving them a moderate Cooldown. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

SupportZenithPlayer.name: Zenith I
SupportZenithPlayer.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportZenithPlayerTwo.name: Zenith II
SupportZenithPlayerTwo.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.name: Zerphi's Infamy
SupportZerphisLegacyPlayer.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Supported Skills gain a Glory requirement, and build Glory when you spend Life on Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage and have significantly\n increased area of effect.

SupportingFirePlayer.name: Supporting Fire
SupportingFirePlayer.description: Recruit artillery Minions that takes up positions behind you. They will lay in wait for your Command then fire volleys of arrows at the target location.

TameBeastPlayer.name: Tame Beast
TameBeastPlayer.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

TemperWeaponCombustionPlayer.name: Combust
TemperWeaponCombustionPlayer.description: Explode, dealing Fire damage in an area.

TemperWeaponPlayer.name: Temper Weapon
TemperWeaponPlayer.description: Channel to temper your main hand Melee Martial Weapon. Each hit of the hammer against the anvil Empowers subsequent Attacks to Combust when Hitting enemies.

TempestBellPlayer.name: Tempest Bell
TempestBellPlayer.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.

TempestFlurryPlayer.name: Tempest Flurry
TempestFlurryPlayer.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.

TemporalChainsPlayer.name: Temporal Chains
TemporalChainsPlayer.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

TemporalRiftPlayer.name: Temporal Rift
TemporalRiftPlayer.description: While active, passively leaves afterimages of your recent past. Cast the Spell to return to the oldest afterimage, teleporting to that location and resetting your Life, Mana and Energy Shield to the values they had at the time.

ThrashingVinesPlayer.name: Thrashing Vines
ThrashingVinesPlayer.description: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.

ThunderousLeapPlayer.name: Thunderous Leap
ThunderousLeapPlayer.description: Leap into the air and plunge your Spear into the ground at the target location, emitting a Lightning-charged shockwave.

ThunderstormPlayer.name: Thunderstorm
ThunderstormPlayer.description: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.

TimeFreezePlayer.name: Time Freeze
TimeFreezePlayer.description: Release a large wave that stops time for all affected enemies for a duration. Duration is lower the more times the enemy has had time stopped for them.

TimeOfNeedPlayer.name: Time of Need
TimeOfNeedPlayer.description: While active, periodically invokes divine blessings to heal you and remove Curses and Elemental Ailments from you.

TimeSnapPlayer.name: Time Snap
TimeSnapPlayer.description: Manipulate time, resetting the cooldowns of your other Skills.

TornadoPlayer.name: Tornado
TornadoPlayer.description: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

TornadoShotPlayer.name: Tornado Shot
TornadoShotPlayer.description: Fire a skyward shot that whips up a Tornado where it lands, dealing Physical damage over time and Hindering enemies standing in it. Arrows, thrown Spears and Crossbow bolts fired at the Tornado are sucked into it, causing the Tornado to spit out a ring of copied Projectiles. Copied Projectiles cannot be copied again, even by further Tornados.

ToxicDomainPlayer.name: Toxic Domain
ToxicDomainPlayer.description: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.

ToxicGrenadePlayer.name: Gas Grenade
ToxicGrenadePlayer.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

ToxicGrowthPlayer.name: Toxic Growth
ToxicGrowthPlayer.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

TrailOfCaltropsPlayer.name: Trail of Caltrops
TrailOfCaltropsPlayer.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.

TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.name: Battershout
TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the Broken Armour of the target which this explosion was Triggered from.

TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.name: Bone Shrapnel Explosion
TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the Pinned target slain.

TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.name: Brambles
TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.description: Hazardous thorns damage and Maim enemies with which they come in contact.

TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription
TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.description: Create Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.

TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops
TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.

TriggeredCatalysingDischargePlayer.name: Catalysing Discharge
TriggeredCatalysingDischargePlayer.description: Triggered when supported skill is boosted by an Elemental Ground Surface to deal damage of the matching Element.

TriggeredCraterPlayer.name: Crater
TriggeredCraterPlayer.description: Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.

TriggeredCreepingChillPlayer.name: Creeping Chill
TriggeredCreepingChillPlayer.description: Creates spreading Chilled Ground around Ice Crystals created by Supported Skills.

TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.name: Doedre's Dark Design
TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.description: Explodes and deals Chaos Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported Curse on Hit.

TriggeredDeadlyCurrentPlayer.name: Coursing Current
TriggeredDeadlyCurrentPlayer.description: Sends a Chaining Lightning Projectile from the Shocked enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing Spell damage.

TriggeredElementalDischargePlayer.name: Elemental Discharge
TriggeredElementalDischargePlayer.description: Triggered when supported skill Consumes Ignite, Shock, or Freeze, to deal damage of Types matching the Consumed Ailments.

TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayer.name: Accelerated Growth
TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayer.description: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.

TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.name: Accelerated Growth
TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.description: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.name: Fan the Flames
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage.

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.name: Fan the Flames
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage.

TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.name: Flame Pillar
TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.

TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.name: Haemocrystals
TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.description: Deal Physical Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Bleed.

TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.name: Grisly Pyre
TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.

TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.name: Poison Spores
TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.description: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which Detonates after a delay, dealing Attack damage. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.name: Quill Burst
TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.description: Deal your Thorns Damage in an Area. Cannot Hit the target this was Triggered from.

TriggeredShockingRiftPlayer.name: Electromagnetism
TriggeredShockingRiftPlayer.description: Pull enemies in and pulse Lightning damage, Hindering enemies Hit. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.name: Skittering Stone
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.name: Skittering Stone
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.

TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.name: Tawhoa's Vengeance
TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.description: Deals Physical Damage in an area, based on Totem Life.

TriggeredStaticShocksPlayer.name: Static Shocks
TriggeredStaticShocksPlayer.description: Attaches a Static Shock to a target that pulses Lightning damage to the attached target and nearby enemies. Targets can have a maximum of one Static Shock attached to them.

TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.name: Ice Fragments
TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.description: Explodes to deal Cold Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.

TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops
TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsPlayer.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.

TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption
TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.description: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck target, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.

TriggeredXibaquasRendingPlayer.name: Fiery Reclamation
TriggeredXibaquasRendingPlayer.description: Deals Fire damage in an area around the exploding Corpse based on its maximum Life.

TrinityPlayer.name: Trinity
TrinityPlayer.description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Resonance based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Resonance of any type you have.

TwisterPlayer.name: Twister
TwisterPlayer.description: Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

UnboundAvatarPlayer.name: Unbound Avatar
UnboundAvatarPlayer.description: Gain Unbound Fury by inflicting Elemental Ailments with Hits on enemies. Once you reach maximum Unbound Fury, consume it to become Unbound for a duration, vastly augmenting your Elemental prowess.

UnbreakableSupportPlayer.name: Unbreakable
UnbreakableSupportPlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, making you harder to Stun while using it.

UnearthPlayer.name: Unearth
UnearthPlayer.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

UniqueBreachLightningBoltPlayer.name: Lightning Bolt
UniqueBreachLightningBoltPlayer.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

UnleashPlayer.name: Unleash
UnleashPlayer.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Spell you cast to repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown.

UnloadAmmoPlayer.name: Basic Bolt
UnloadAmmoPlayer.description: Clear your active Bolt and reload any ammunition.

ValakosChargePlayer.name: Valako's Charge
ValakosChargePlayer.description: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

VaultingImpactPlayer.name: Vaulting Impact
VaultingImpactPlayer.description: Leap forward and Slam the ground, sending out a shockwave. The shockwave applies Broken Stance to Dazed enemies, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

ViciousHexSupportPlayer.name: Impending Doom
ViciousHexSupportPlayer.description: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

VileDisruptionPlayer.name: His Vile Intrusion
VileDisruptionPlayer.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

VineArrowPlayer.name: Vine Arrow
VineArrowPlayer.description: Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.

VoidIllusionPlayer.name: Void Illusion
VoidIllusionPlayer.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will cause damaging explosions. Copies created this way have 1 Life.

VolatileDeadPlayer.name: Volatile Dead
VolatileDeadPlayer.description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.

VolcanicFissurePlayer.name: Volcanic Fissure
VolcanicFissurePlayer.description: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.

VolcanoPlayer.name: Volcano
VolcanoPlayer.description: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.

VoltaicMarkPlayer.name: Voltaic Mark
VoltaicMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.

VulnerabilityPlayer.name: Vulnerability
VulnerabilityPlayer.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay. making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

WalkingCalamityPlayer.name: Walking Calamity
WalkingCalamityPlayer.description: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.

WarBannerReservationPlayer.name: War Banner
WarBannerReservationPlayer.description: While active, Attacking enemies builds Glory. When you have maximum Glory, you can place an inspiring Banner for a duration with an Aura that grants you and nearby Allies Attack damage, Attack speed and Accuracy.

WaveOfFrostPlayer.name: Wave of Frost
WaveOfFrostPlayer.description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.name: Chaos Bolt
WeaponGrantedChaosboltPlayer.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

WhirlingAssaultPlayer.name: Whirling Assault
WhirlingAssaultPlayer.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

WhirlingSlashPlayer.name: Whirling Slash
WhirlingSlashPlayer.description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.

WhirlwindLancePlayer.name: Whirlwind Lance
WhirlwindLancePlayer.description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

WindDancerPlayer.name: Wind Dancer
WindDancerPlayer.description: While active, periodically grants stages of a buff that gives you more Evasion per stage. Being Hit by an Enemy while you have this buff consumes all stages to damage and Knock Back enemies around you.

WindSerpentsFuryPlayer.name: Wind Serpent's Fury
WindSerpentsFuryPlayer.description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

WingBlastPlayer.name: Wing Blast
WingBlastPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

WitherPlayer.name: Wither
WitherPlayer.description: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.

WitheringPresencePlayer.name: Withering Presence
WitheringPresencePlayer.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

WolfArcticHowlPlayer.name: Arctic Howl
WolfArcticHowlPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

WolfCrossSlashPlayer.name: Cross Slash
WolfCrossSlashPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

WolfCrossSlashWolfPlayer.name: Summon Wolf
WolfCrossSlashWolfPlayer.description: This skill is Triggered when Predator's Mark Activates to Summon a Wolf Minion that follows you as long as it lives.

WolfLunarBlessingPlayer.name: Lunar Blessing
WolfLunarBlessingPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.

WolfPackPlayer.name: Wolf Pack
WolfPackPlayer.description: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

WolfPounceMarkPlayer.name: Predator's Mark
WolfPounceMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the Mark will Activate to Trigger the Summon Wolf skill and Consume the Mark.

WolfPouncePlayer.name: Pounce
WolfPouncePlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.

WolfShredPlayer.name: Shred
WolfShredPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.

WyvernDevourPlayer.name: Devour
WyvernDevourPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.

WyvernFlameBreathPlayer.name: Flame Breath
WyvernFlameBreathPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to Empower the Skill, Gaining extra Lightning damage and spending Rage more slowly.

WyvernRendPlayer.name: Rend
WyvernRendPlayer.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
